title: Google’s revived nuclear power plant gets $1.9B loan from US government
summary: Google is reviving an Iowa nuclear power plant, and the owner has secured a $1.9B loan from the U.S. Energy Department to support the project. This reflects growing investment in nuclear energy as a potential solution for power-hungry data centers and AI infrastructure.
content: Google said it would bring an Iowa nuclear power plant back from the dead. Now, the plant's owner is getting a $1.9B loan from the U.S. Energy Department.

title: JBL’s soundbar with detachable rear speakers is over $300 off
summary: JBL's Bar 700 Mark 2 soundbar system with modular, battery-powered rear speakers is on sale at Amazon for $549.99, down from $899.99. The system offers 7.1 channels with Dolby Atmos and up to 10-hour battery life on the detachable speakers.
content:
A lot of people are split between getting a nice all-in-one soundbar or spending more for an option that includes rear satellites for immersive surround sound. JBL’s Bar 700 Mark 2 system is one of the most unique options available, shipping with two modular speakers that charge when docked to the soundbar. When detached, the battery-powered (and mountable) speakers can be placed anywhere, lasting for up to ten hours before needing to recharge. If you’re seeking this kind of versatility, you might be pleased to know that the system has been steeply discounted at Amazon, costing $549.99 (originally $899.99).
JBL Bar 700 Mark 2

Where to Buy:

 $900 $550 at Amazon

The Bar 700 Mark 2 seems impressive on multiple fronts. The main soundbar component offers 7.1 channels, including two tweeters that fire to the side to bounce around audio with Dolby Atmos and DTS Virtual:X content. It offers vastly superior connectivity compared to some similarly-priced options, with HDMI in (with HDR 10 Plus and Dolby Vision passthrough), HDMI out with ARC and eARC support, plus optical audio. The set includes a wireless subwoofer, plus mounts.
One of the most appealing use cases for the Bar 700 Mark 2 is bringing one of its satellites with you around your house or apartment so you don’t totally miss out on the action. If the speaker’s battery is running low before you’re ready to return it to the soundbar, you can easily recharge it just by plugging in a USB-C power source.

title: Nintendo’s Ocarina of Time remake launches in November
summary: Nintendo announced that the Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 will launch on November 5th, positioning it among major titles releasing alongside Grand Theft Auto VI. The remake will mark the first 3D Zelda adventure in the franchise's 40th anniversary year.
content:

Nintendo first teased the remake in June, though it didn't reveal much aside from a brief trailer. Today's event provided a clearer glimpse at how the company is approaching remaking one of its most influential games and the first 3D Zelda adventure. title: Microsoft breaks another patch Tuesday record
summary: Microsoft is setting a new patch Tuesday record for security updates this month, marking the third record in just a few months. The surge is driven by AI models like Anthropic's Mythos and OpenAI's cybersecurity tools rapidly identifying vulnerabilities in operating systems and browsers.
content:
Engineers at Microsoft typically enjoy a quieter summer to take vacations and spend time with family, as is common at many companies. But this year, the season has been unusually busy for Windows and security engineers, thanks to new AI models that are discovering software vulnerabilities at a rapid pace. Sources tell me that Microsoft will set another patch Tuesday record today, the third in just a few months.
It all kicked off in April when Anthropic's new Mythos model found security vulnerabilities in "every major operating system and web browser." A few weeks later, OpenAI released its own cybersecurity-focused model to trusted partners …

summary: Google DeepMind has unveiled AlphaGenome Atlas, an AI tool that maps every possible DNA letter change in the human genome. The predictive tool could accelerate biological research and help identify new disease treatments by analyzing the three billion letter pairs of DNA.
content:
Google DeepMind has unveiled an AI tool that its scientists claim could help unravel the mysteries of the human genome and transform our understanding of biology, accelerating scientific research and ultimately paving the way for new treatments for diseases.  
The platform, called AlphaGenome Atlas, contains a "predictive map of every possible DNA letter change in the human genome,"  the researchers said in a blog post published on Tuesday.

title: The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct: All the news and trailers
summary: Nintendo held a Zelda Direct event celebrating the franchise's 40th anniversary, announcing the November 5th launch of the Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 and revealing new merchandise. The event also teased upcoming projects including a live-action movie in 2027 and a concert tour.
content:
The Legend of Zelda franchise turns 40 this year, and Nintendo has some news in store. The company is airing a Zelda-themed Direct on September 8th at 10AM ET (it’s actually the first of two news-filled events), which is expected to last around 30 minutes and, according to Nintendo, will include a “variety of information related to The Legend of Zelda.”
That’s a pretty vague description, but the event will almost certainly include more details on the upcoming Ocarina of Time remake for the Switch 2, which currently doesn’t have a release date, as well as the live-action Zelda movie that hits theaters in 2027. But given the length of the event, there will likely be some surprises as well. Hey, maybe we’ll see a tease for the next mainline Zelda adventure.

title: Intel CPUs are reportedly getting a 10 percent price hike in October

title: Xiaomi’s wide foldable promises more power than Samsung’s
summary: Xiaomi released the 18 Fold, a short, wide foldable phone with superior specs compared to Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8. The device has a roughly 1.4:1 aspect ratio on both its 7.58-inch inner and 5.38-inch outer screens, making it both shorter and wider than Samsung's offering. The launch intensifies competition in the foldable market as Apple prepares to enter the segment.
content:
Xiaomi is the latest manufacturer to release a short, wide foldable phone, in the week Apple is expected to do the same. I got to try the 18 Fold behind closed doors at IFA last week, and while it looks and feels similar enough to Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8, superior specs make it feel like the phone I wish Samsung had made.
The 18 Fold is Xiaomi's first book-style foldable since 2024's Mix Fold 4, but the company has followed Huawei and Samsung in moving to a short, squat design. title: Eric Wu’s newest company, out of stealth since May, is going after construction’s labor crunch
summary: Eric Wu's NavigateAI provides AI-powered real-time guidance to construction workers through smartphones and Meta's AI glasses to address the sector's labor shortage. The company, which emerged from stealth in May, has raised $25 million from investors including Khosla Ventures and Lennar. The tool aims to tackle a crisis where major projects like data centers require thousands of additional workers.
content: Eric Wu, who built and ran Opendoor before stepping away in 2022, has had his new company, NavigateAI, out of stealth since May — building AI copilots that give construction workers real-time, hands-free guidance through smartphones and Meta's AI glasses, backed by $25 million from Elad Gil, Khosla Ventures, and Lennar to tackle a labor shortage severe enough that data center projects alone now need 4,000 to 5,000 workers apiece.
